title: SETU Clinical Evidence
description: A provenance-preserving clinical fact exchanged between PRISM, document intelligence, interoperability adapters, and downstream clinical services.

id.description: Stable identifier for this evidence item within its containing session or record.

kind.description: Machine-readable clinical concept or evidence kind, for example symptom, allergy, medication, diagnosis, lab_result, or ayush_prakriti.

language.description: BCP 47 language tag for the original patient-facing content when known.

originalValue.description: The value as captured from the source, before normalization.

value.description: Structured or scalar representation used by downstream services.

system.description: Terminology/code system, such as SNOMED CT, LOINC, ICD-10, or a SETU internal vocabulary.

certainty.description: Semantic certainty of the claim; this is distinct from extraction confidence.

confidence.description: System confidence in capture or extraction. It must not be interpreted as clinical certainty.

locator.description: Human- or machine-resolvable location within the source, such as page, section, FHIR resource id, or document region.

metadata.description: Non-clinical implementation metadata. Do not place secrets or raw patient identifiers here.
